scope: Diagnose existing failed PTQ on training data only. Not a fresh evaluation or a hardware kernel benchmark.
source: All3 fixed trained seed FP32/QDQ artifacts from deployment_audit final job129720
samples: First8 of the fixed64 training-only PTQ calibration paths; same exact image/preprocessing for float and quant graph
probes: Same QDQ graph default vs disabled graph optimisation; no model/calibration change
Float graph vs QDQ graph with all Conv outputs visible and optimisation disabled, calculate each layer relative RMSE and cosine
FP32 vs dequantised int8 weight arrays, per Conv node
Activation representable interval and fraction of float Conv outputs outside its frozen QDQ range
ranking: Find first Conv with median per-image relative RMSE>=0.2; retain all layers and seeds. Ranking and any subsequent exclusion recipe use these training observations only.
no_changes: Do not adjust source64 calibration, validation thresholds, trained checkpoints or previous evaluation outcomes. Keep reserved future identities outside inference.
acceptance: Record causal boundaries and evidence; no automatic rule declares the whole INT8 approach unsuitable. If kernel-only explanation fails the identical graph control, report that and continue activation/weight investigation.
